entries.name: TokKind
entries.code:
TokKind = enum
  tEOF, tNewline, tIndent, tDedent, tFR, tNumber, tString, tFStr, tIdent, tLet,
  tBe, tLock, tNocap, tCap, tGhost, tBoth, tEither, tAint, tNah, tLiterally,
  tAintLiterally, tUpIn, tAintUpIn, tVibecheck, tOr, tOtherwise, tVibe,
  tForReal, tDip, tNext, tDeadass, tCook, tSendIt, tDrop, tCallUp, tYo, tClique,
  tNew, tFam, tAncestor, tPullUp, tOutta, tAs, tGives, tSus, tFAround, tFindOut,
  tNoMatterWhat, tThrowShade, tRollWith, tOnTiming, tOnGod, tWaitUp, tMiniVibe,
  tWorldwide, tLocalish, tCancel, tFitCheck, tFit, tYap, tYapBack,
  tVibeCheckType, tHowMany, tAddUp, tRoundUp, tIndexUp, tPlus, tMinus, tStar,
  tSlash, tSlashSlash, tPercent, tStarStar, tEqEq, tNotEq, tLt, tGt, tLe, tGe,
  tAssign, tPlusEq, tMinusEq, tStarEq, tSlashEq, tSlashSlashEq, tPercentEq,
  tStarStarEq, tBePlus, tBeMinus, tBeStar, tBeSlash, tBeSlashSlash, tBePercent,
  tBeStarStar, tLParen, tRParen, tLBracket, tRBracket, tLBrace, tRBrace, tComma,
  tColon, tDot, tQuestion

entries.name: Token
entries.code:
Token = object
  kind*: TokKind
  text*: string
  line*: int
  col*: int

entries.name: tokDesc
entries.code:
proc tokDesc(k: TokKind; text: string): string {.raises: [], tags: [],
    forbids: [].}
entries.description: Human-readable description of a token for error messages.
